procedural_issues_en: The itemized statement was received on August 24, three days after the computed August 21 deadline. Connecticut law provides for double damages for a violation; Rentrail computed that amount as $8,600. A local tenant-rights group or lawyer should confirm how to pursue it. [CT-47a-21-d2]

The statement's refund amount ($3,017.60) equals the deposit less the listed deductions and does not include the computed $21.01 accrued interest. Request the interest; the interest-only statutory remedy is addressed separately in the law. [CT-47a-21-d2] [CT-47a-21-i]

The provided facts do not establish whether the landlord sent the required written escrow notice identifying the amount held and the financial institution within 30 days. Check for that notice. [CT-47a-21-h1] [CT-47a-21-h4]

ruling.ruling_en: Allow only $412.40 in deductions: $350 for the new bedroom crack and $62.40 for the final water/sewer bill. The other claimed charges are disallowed because the cited damage was pre-existing, unsupported, or inconsistent with the key-return facts. The resulting deposit balance is $3,887.60; adding the stated $21.01 interest makes the requested payment $3,908.61. The itemized statement arrived three days after the stated deadline, potentially triggering double damages under [CT-47a-21-d2]; obtain local tenant-rights or legal advice before pursuing that separate remedy, and check whether the required escrow notice was sent.
ruling.ruling_ko: 인정할 공제액은 새 침실 벽 균열 수리비 350달러와 최종 수도·하수도 요금 62.40달러, 합계 412.40달러입니다. 나머지는 기존 손상, 입증 부족 또는 열쇠 반환 사실과 맞지 않아 인정하지 않습니다. 보증금 잔액 3,887.60달러에 제시된 이자 21.01달러를 더하면 청구할 금액은 3,908.61달러입니다. 정산서가 기한보다 3일 늦어 [CT-47a-21-d2]에 따른 두 배 배상 문제가 있을 수 있으므로 별도 구제 방법은 지역 세입자 단체나 변호사에게 확인하고, 에스크로 통지 수령 여부도 확인하세요.
ruling.letter_en:
[PERSON_1]

Re: Security deposit accounting

Dear Landlord,

I dispute the deductions for Living room floor plank replacement, Hallway wall patch and repaint near light switch, Professional carpet cleaning, and Rekeying - unreturned key. The same floor gouge is visible in Exhibit E2, move-in evidence, and Exhibit E12, move-out evidence; the same hallway chip is visible in Exhibit E4, move-in evidence, and Exhibit E14, move-out evidence. These conditions were pre-existing, not tenant-caused damage. Lease p. 3 does not make them deductible under [CT-47a-21-a14] and [CT-47a-11]. The lease’s carpet-cleaning charge, also on p. 3, is not supported by evidence of tenant-caused excess dirt. I returned the keys on July 31, 2027, so the rekeying charge is not applicable (lease p. 1).

I accept $350 for Bedroom wall crack repair and repaint, shown in Exhibit E20, move-out evidence, July 31, 2027, and $62.40 for Final water/sewer bill (Conservice), subject to the itemized final bill. The lease addresses these respective obligations on pp. 3 and 2. After these deductions and the stated $21.01 accrued interest, please pay me **$3,908.61**.

I provided my forwarding address and returned the keys on July 31, 2027. The itemized statement was received August 24, after the August 21 deadline. Under [CT-47a-21-d2], that delay may trigger double damages; the stated calculation is $8,600. I reserve that separate claim and will seek advice from a local tenant-rights group or lawyer about pursuing it. Please also confirm whether you sent the written escrow notice required by [CT-47a-21-h4].

Please send the payment and respond to this letter within 10 days. The exhibits referenced above are attached by Rentrail.

Sincerely,
[PERSON_1]
ruling.letter_ko_summary: [PERSON_1] 명의의 영어 서한은 근거가 부족하거나 사실과 맞지 않는 네 항목의 공제를 다투고, 침실 균열 수리비 350달러와 수도·하수도 요금 62.40달러는 인정합니다. 이자 21.01달러를 더한 정확한 환급 요청액은 3,908.61달러입니다. 정산서 지연에 따른 별도 두 배 배상 가능성과 에스크로 통지 여부를 언급하고, 10일 이내 회신을 요청합니다.
